en.title: The Medici: banking partnerships, papal finance, Renaissance politics and the limits of private capital
en.deck: A monetary and institutional reconstruction of the Medici banking network, Florence's wool and silk economy, papal contracting, patronage, political power and 1494 collapse.
en.regime: Cross-border private finance and contested public and political authority.
en.key_risk: Mistaking banking access and family historical prominence for all-encompassing political or monetary sovereignty.

pt-BR.title: Os Medici: sociedades bancárias, finanças papais, política renascentista e limites do capital privado
pt-BR.deck: Reconstrução monetária e institucional da rede Medici, economia têxtil de Florença, finanças papais, mecenato, poder político e crise de 1494.
pt-BR.regime: Financiamento privado transfronteiriço e autoridade pública e política contestada.
pt-BR.key_risk: Confundir acesso bancário e prestígio histórico de famílias com soberania monetária ou política ilimitada.
watch: Direitos jurídicos de propriedade e das contrapartes

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 24 October 2026; archival and scholarly sources dated in bibliography.
producer_checks.editorial_novelty: Expanded multi-generational history of Giovanni, Cosimo, Lorenzo and later duchy, political and papal offices; English and Burgundian loan risk and Portinari's dual roles.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Two quantified, semantically matched bilingual charts; chronology, flow, geographical map.
producer_checks.source_check: Twelve independent indexed archival, academic, art-history and institutional sources; chronological offices, estates and banking legal entities separated.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Substantive parallel multi-generational EN/PT chapters and quantitative charts retained.
producer_checks.methodology: Cross-check family archive against academic/court/government source; avoid unverified historical fortune or covert-control claims.
